description: B-307b verification (2026-05-16, c029): extends the 4..128 ladder to 256 and 512 to exercise the despawn_all + respawn_swarm path past Mike's playtest crash trigger. Mike's playtest log Build/pd-client.1.log captured a silent process exit ~6s after the cycle 256->512 fired (despawn_all freed 254 chrs, then crash before respawn_ring's log line). Fix: swarm_drain_death_state() drains transient ACT_DIE/ACT_DEAD pointers (chr->cover, chr->target, act_die.notifychrindex, fadealpha) before chrRemove + propFree. This regression test cycles through 256 AND 512 with stable dwell time to catch any recurrence. Prior history: c115 iter-3 (2026-05-14) confirmed 4..128 stable; B-307 was first thought to be CHRVTX pool exhaustion (c029 715424c4) but recurs at 256->512 with the new fail-fast 0xC0000409 signature.

input_sequence.comment: boot path: --launch-scenario seeds testScenarioLaunch(SWARM_CPU) post-catalog-init. matchStart() routes through MP arena base:mp_felicity stagenum (initial count=4). FINDING: player pos is uninitialised at this point, so respawn_ring fails (spawned=0) and the match ends ~5s later into an endscreen_solo menu, which pushes imgui_menu IMC on top and suppresses ACTION_TESTSCEN_CYCLE_COUNT via gameplayInputSuppressed(). The cycle attempts below will fire harness-side but cycler_tick will not fire until the endscreen is dismissed AND a fresh match starts on a properly-positioned player.

input_sequence.comment: dismiss endscreen_solo via continue (may restart match)

input_sequence.name: ACTION_TESTSCEN_CYCLE_COUNT
input_sequence.comment: cycle 128 -> 256 (B-307 prior trigger; now stable via CHRVTX 4096 bump)

input_sequence.name: ACTION_TESTSCEN_CYCLE_COUNT
input_sequence.comment: cycle 256 -> 512 (B-307b trigger from Mike playtest 2026-05-16). With swarm_drain_death_state fix the process must survive this cycle. Dwell 30s at 256 first so death-state chrs accumulate, mirroring Mike's playtest timing exactly.
exit 40s after the 256 -> 512 cycle fires. Mike's playtest crashed within 6s of the cycle; 40s is plenty for the bot AI tick + propsTickPlayer to surface any latent death-state dangling pointer.
